market_data_policy: Every quote shows its own observation date. If the scheduled provider fetch fails, keep the last verified observation with a clear stale indicator. Never invent real-time market ticks.
limitations: FX is BI middle of transaction buy/sell quotes, not intraday USD/IDR streaming.
IHSG is a delayed vendor snapshot; provider time is ambiguous and cannot be presented as current close.
GII ranks innovation inputs/outputs, not total investment climate. UNCTAD worldwide FDI is not an Indonesian rank.
Kearney Emerging Markets Index is a forward-looking survey ranking of 25 emerging economies, not Indonesia's ranking in the global all-economies list.
